summary: Revalidate a source snapshot before admission and independently check traversal components; use immutable access-label tuples; compare file identity, size and nanosecond modification/change times without access-time false positives.
API: parse_manifest and OriginalStore.admit/inspect retain their roles; Source.access_labels is now an immutable tuple. Metadata changes require a freshly validated source and produce a distinct revision.

tests.result: 8 passed, including forged traversal without publication, immutable ACL, old-atime source and store, and existing positive and negative journeys

limitations: Synthetic local fixtures only; no real corpus, services or hardware qualification.
A private operator-controlled local POSIX store and filesystem supporting hard links and directory fsync remain required.
No authentication, rights-authority attestation, extraction, source serving, legal approval or MVP acceptance is claimed.
